title: Advanced Energy Systems Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Storage, power conversion, grid management, and experimentally supported performance. The Advanced Energy Systems Database documents energy technology as engineering: storage (batteries, hydrogen, thermal, mechanical), power conversion (inverters, converters, efficiency curves), grid management (balancing, reserves, stability), and performance numbers with experimental support. Energy claims are cheap; measured round-trip efficiency is not — every performance record cites its test conditions and distinguishes lab results from field results.

title: Advanced Energy Systems Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Storage: batteries (Li-ion: 250 Wh/kg, 90-95% round-trip; LFP safer/longer; flow batteries for duration; sodium-ion emerging), hydrogen (electrolysis ~70%, fuel cell ~50%, round-trip ~35% — use where duration beats efficiency), thermal (hot water/molten salt, cheap at scale), mechanical (pumped hydro 80%, flywheels for power quality). Conversion: DC-DC, DC-AC inverters (efficiency curves peak at 50-80% load; THD for power quality), transformers. Grid: supply must equal demand every second; frequency control (inertia, fast reserves); duck curve (solar midday surplus, evening ramp). Sizing: energy (kWh for duration) vs power (kW for peak) — both constraints bind. Degradation: batteries lose capacity with cycles and calendar age; model it. Efficiency chains multiply: 0.95 * 0.90 * 0.97 = 0.83 end-to-end.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');

demo.title: Execution: Hohmann transfer delta-v
demo.code: const mu=398600;function circ(r){return Math.sqrt(mu/r);}const r1=6678,r2=42164;const a=(r1+r2)/2;const dv1=Math.abs(Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r1-1/a))-circ(r1));const dv2=Math.abs(circ(r2)-Math.sqrt(mu*(2/r2-1/a)));J({dv1:+dv1.toFixed(2),dv2:+dv2.toFixed(2),total:+(dv1+dv2).toFixed(2)});assert(dv1+dv2>3.8&&dv1+dv2<4.0,'hohmann');
